question: Which state's government launched a free bus service for women, aimed at making travel easier and more comfortable?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah launched a free bus service for women at Sher-i-Kashmir International Conference Centre (SKICC).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Omar Abdullah, the Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, launched the free bus service for women on April 1, 2025.**
 
• **The initiative aims to make travel easier and more comfortable for women in the Union Territory.**
 
• **Ministers Satish Sharma and Sakina Itoo were also present at the launch event.**
 
• **The service was launched at the Sher-i-Kashmir International Conference Centre (SKICC) in Srinagar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sher-i-Kashmir International Conference Centre (SKICC)__

 
 
• A prominent conference venue in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, known for hosting major events and functions.
